title: Signer coverage
intro: Every Signer operation the emulator advertises, and what Emuplane does with it.
The service is REST/JSON on `/signing-jobs` and `/signing-profiles`, signed with the
`signer` credential scope, and has no console action. Signing is synchronous: a job
reads its source object out of the local S3 store and writes the signed object to the
destination bucket before `StartSigningJob` returns, so the job is already `Succeeded`.
Without ACM-held signing material the object is a JSON receipt rather than a signature.
Profiles are records; a cancelled profile keeps its name and its permissions.
